create.behavior: Allocates 920 bytes with operator new then invokes QcomCameraImpl constructor. Do not allocate opaque class storage in caller.

destroy.behavior: Null guard then invoke virtual deleting destructor at vtable offset 8.

hookModuleInit.behavior: No-op (BTI; RET), Qcom uses inherited method.

setClientPackageName.behavior: String16 package stored in cameraId-keyed map at this+0x20; int API version stored in map at this+0x48; latest package copy stored at this+0xc8 under mutex.

setClientActivityName.behavior: Calls setClientActivityName on CameraSceneIdentify from cameraId-keyed map at this+0x70.

parseCustomizedJsonData.behavior: Looks up registered package/activity then passes those and cameraId to CameraCustomize::parseCustomizedJsonData. Supplies per-camera customization mask checked by executeSceneIdentify.

initializeDeviceInfo.behavior: Reads com.xiaomi.cameraid.role.cameraId static tag, stores per-camera role map this+0x358 and latest role this+0x33c. No direct use of these fields found in executeSceneIdentify.

updateSessionParams.behavior: Does not write MiStreamUsecase or activityName. clientName is the package previously registered for this cameraId.

createCustomDefaultRequest.behavior: Applies package-aware default request adjustments and clientName/customization tags. Does not write MiStreamUsecase.

executeSceneIdentify.behavior: Runs CameraSceneIdentify with stream configuration; optional per-camera customization bit1 forces usecase 4; logs usecase at 0x722cc; metadata int32 update at 0x72348. Activity written as NUL-terminated bytes, maximum 127 payload bytes.

detachSceneIdentify.behavior: Erases MiStreamUsecase only after HAL configure; leaves clientName and activityName.

notifyRequestSubmit.behavior: Only delegates to optional CameraIntentAwareSingleton; no session-map mutation.

notifyCancelRequest.behavior: Only delegates to optional CameraIntentAwareSingleton; no session-map mutation.

notifyCameraDisconnect.behavior: Delegates to optional CameraIntentAwareSingleton; fifth explicit int==1 additionally reports CameraOpt status 4. Does not erase per-camera maps or scenes.

factory_findings.correction: The observed normal capture hooks are native frameworks/av code. Earlier claims that this requires wholesale framework.jar/services.jar replacement are unsupported by the recovered configure call path.

intentional_differences: Load lazily once per process with RTLD_NOW|RTLD_LOCAL, resolve all selected exports, allocate through create, call hookModuleInit and retain object/handle for process lifetime. A failure logs once and leaves calls as no-ops.

Factory dispatches virtual CameraStub methods after resolving create. Adapter resolves the measured exported CameraImpl base methods by mangled name with an explicit opaque this pointer; the supplied Qcom implementation inherits these methods.
Register activity and package together in the validated API1/API2 client constructor. Keep the framework validated package identity; do not alter attribution or permission checks.
Own a mutable CameraMetadata copy around configureStreamsLocked instead of casting away constness on caller metadata; complete raw-buffer cloning retains the vendor ID.
Log tag presence/type/count and MiStreamUsecase value before the HAL call, plus configureStreams status for acceptance evidence.
